_README: INSTANCE ESTATE CONFIG — your estate's knowledge, private to this repo.
This is the middle of three levels (see .meta-os/systems/config.md):
framework  — .meta-os/systems/meta-os.config.schema.json : valid keys + defaults, ZERO values, public
instance   — THIS FILE, at the instance root beside CLAUDE.md : estate knowledge, private
deployment — the dashboard's instance.config.json : where the instance is, auth, CORS, dataDir
Keeping estate knowledge here (not in the dashboard's config) is what lets a skill or
a sync script read your estate with the dashboard uninstalled.
Every key is OPTIONAL. Delete this file entirely and you get default behaviour:
the instance's own memory/{raw,wiki,output} as the sole canon root, plus vaults/* as
federated mounts. Nothing here is required to start.
Replace the ${...} placeholders below with your own paths, or delete what you don't use.
A deployment may override any of these keys; this file supplies the defaults.

vars._comment: Reusable prefixes. ${name} expands in any value here and in a projects/*.md 'path:', so moving your checkout is a one-line change.

backlogs._comment: One entry per space/project you track. 'path' is the space directory in a per-item backlog; a path ending in .json reads a legacy pre-built backlog document instead.

memory._comment: OMIT this whole block for the default topology. Declare it only when memory lives somewhere other than the instance's own memory/ directory.

roots._comment: Canon roots ARE the raw->wiki->output pipeline — their notes count as promotable. layout: flat | tier/project | project/tier. Use project/tier when the root is federated one-symlink-per-project.
roots.label: instance

federated._comment: Federated mounts are surfaced for navigation and context but NEVER counted as canon. A dangling path is skipped and reported, never fatal.
federated.label: some-project
